meta.name: data-engineering
meta.description: Builds and operates data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, orchestration, quality testing, and reliability of data delivery. Use this to design or debug a pipeline, decide batch versus streaming, add data quality checks, handle late or duplicate data, or work out why a dashboard's numbers changed without anyone changing the dashboard.

copy.tagline: 搭建和运维数据管道,让数据处理稳定可靠
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要搭建或维护公司里的数据管道,关心数据质量与交付可靠性
copy.tagline_en: Design and operate data pipelines for reliable, timely data delivery.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build or maintain pipelines and care about data quality and delivery reliability.

howto.what: Claude会协助你设计或调试数据管道：决定批处理还是流式、添加数据质量检查、处理迟到或重复数据、解释仪表板数字变化。它会建议保留原始数据、保证重复运行不重复计数、按事件时间聚合。
howto.when: 当你设计或调试数据管道、决定批处理还是流式、排查数据质量问题(如迟到、重复、仪表板数字异常)时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一条从日志到报表的数据管道
say.note: Claude会给出分层建议和每一步的要点。

say.text: 这个管道重跑会重复计数,怎么改成幂等?
say.note: Claude会检查键设计和写入方式,给出合并方案。

say.text: 仪表板数字变了但没人改过,查查原因
say.note: Claude会引导你定位是数据延迟还是重复导致的。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you design or debug data pipelines: choose batch vs streaming, add data quality checks, handle late or duplicate data, and explain dashboard number changes. It advises keeping raw data, making reruns safe from double-counting, and aggregating by event time.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you design or debug a pipeline, decide batch vs streaming, or investigate data-quality issues like lateness, duplicates, or unexpected dashboard numbers.

say_en.text: Design a data pipeline from logs to a dashboard.
say_en.note: Claude suggests staging and key steps.

say_en.text: This pipeline double-counts on rerun. How do I make it idempotent?
say_en.note: Claude checks keys and writes merges instead of appends.

say_en.text: Dashboard numbers changed but nobody edited it. Investigate.
say_en.note: Claude guides you to check late or duplicate data.
